policies.name: cash_games_read
policies.using:
((NOT COALESCE((((ruleset_snapshot -> 'options'::text) ->> 'is_private'::text))::boolean, false)) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM club_members cm
  WHERE ((cm.club_id = cash_games.club_id) AND (cm.user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))))))

policies.name: Users can view their own transactions
policies.using: ((( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid) = performed_by) OR (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid) = from_entity_id) OR (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid) = to_entity_id))

policies.name: Club staff can read club rosters
policies.using:
(is_club_admin(club_id, ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM clubs c
  WHERE ((c.id = club_members.club_id) AND (c.owner_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))))))

policies.name: Members can read own club memberships
Users can join clubs
policies.check: ((user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (COALESCE(credit_limit, (0)::numeric) = (0)::numeric) AND (COALESCE(credit_used, (0)::numeric) = (0)::numeric) AND (agent_id IS NULL) AND (parent_agent_id IS NULL) AND ((role = ANY (ARRAY['member'::text, 'player'::text])) OR is_club_admin(club_id, ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))))

policies.name: cashier_downline_read
policies.using: ((fn_club_cashier_scope(club_id, ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) = 'downline'::text) AND fn_club_cashier_can_transact(club_id, ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), user_id))

policies.name: club_members_update
policies.check: (is_club_admin(club_id, ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR ((user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (role = ANY (ARRAY['member'::text, 'player'::text])) AND (COALESCE(credit_limit, (0)::numeric) = (0)::numeric) AND (COALESCE(credit_used, (0)::numeric) = (0)::numeric) AND (agent_id IS NULL) AND (parent_agent_id IS NULL)))
policies.using: ((user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR is_club_admin(club_id, ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)))

policies.name: union_overseer_read
policies.using: (( SELECT fn_is_any_union_overseer(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AS fn_is_any_union_overseer) AND fn_union_oversees_club(club_id, ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)))

policies.name: rake_records_read
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM club_members cm
  WHERE ((cm.club_id = rake_records.club_id) AND (cm.user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (cm.role = ANY (ARRAY['owner'::text, 'co_owner'::text, 'admin'::text, 'agent'::text])))))

policies.name: union_overseer_read
policies.using: (( SELECT fn_is_any_union_overseer(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AS fn_is_any_union_overseer) AND fn_union_oversees_club(club_id, ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)))

policies.name: union_overseer_read
policies.using:
(( SELECT fn_is_any_union_overseer(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AS fn_is_any_union_overseer) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM tables t
  WHERE ((t.id = table_seats.table_id) AND fn_is_union_overseer(t.union_id, ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))))))

policies.name: poker_arena_diamond_tables
policies.using:
((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM clubs c
  WHERE ((c.id = tables.club_id) AND (c.asset = 'diamonds'::text)))) AND fn_poker_can_read_games(club_id))

policies.name: poker_arena_table_access
policies.using:
(((club_id IS NULL) AND (union_id IS NULL)) OR (COALESCE(union_id, club_id) IN ( SELECT c.id
   FROM clubs c
  WHERE fn_poker_can_read_games(c.id))))

policies.name: tables_select_scoped
policies.using:
((COALESCE(is_private, false) = false) OR (club_id IS NULL) OR is_club_member(club_id, ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM clubs c
  WHERE ((c.id = tables.club_id) AND (c.owner_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))))) OR fn_union_oversees_club(club_id, ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)))

policies.name: tpay_read_self_field_or_staff
policies.using:
((user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM tournament_players tp
  WHERE ((tp.tournament_id = tournament_payouts.tournament_id) AND (tp.user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))))) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM tournaments t
  WHERE ((t.id = tournament_payouts.tournament_id) AND (t.club_id IS NOT NULL) AND fn_is_club_admin_uid(t.club_id)))))

policies.name: cashier_tournament_tickets_read
policies.using: ((issued_by = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR (holder_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR (fn_club_cashier_scope(club_id, ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) = 'all'::text))

policies.name: poker_arena_tournament_access

policies.name: tournaments_select_scoped

policies.name: unions_read
policies.using:
((owner_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM union_admins ua
  WHERE ((ua.union_id = unions.id) AND (ua.user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))))))
